segment_contamination_dimensions: FRP/fibre-reinforced plastic toilet buyers — sibling 'FRP Portable Toilet' (ID 145136) and 'FRP Modular Toilet' (ID 126794) serve buyers specifically seeking non-metal composite construction; names implying FRP or fibre material are excluded.

Vehicle-mounted mobile toilet buyers — siblings 'Mobile Toilet Van' (ID 44109) and 'Mobile Toilets' (ID 45789) serve buyers seeking wheel-mounted or vehicle-integrated sanitation units; names implying vehicular mobility (van, truck-mounted, on-wheels) are excluded.
Bio-digester toilet buyers — sibling 'Bio Toilet' (ID 119106) serves buyers seeking biological waste treatment systems; names implying bio-digester or bio-tank treatment are excluded.
Chemical toilet buyers — sibling 'Chemical Toilets' (ID 156755) serves buyers seeking chemical waste containment units; names implying chemical treatment or holding tanks are excluded.
Sintex/plastic brand-specific buyers — sibling 'Sintex Portable Toilets' (ID 182628) serves buyers seeking Sintex-branded plastic units; brand-specific or plastic-material names are excluded.

Permanent partition/cubicle buyers — siblings 'Toilet Cubicles' (ID 42586) and 'Toilet Partitions' (ID 42587) serve buyers seeking fixed interior partition systems, not relocatable cabin units; names implying fixed partitions or cubicle fitouts are excluded.

Modular toilet buyers (material-agnostic) — sibling 'Modular Toilet' (ID 224049) covers material-agnostic modular systems; names that drop the MS/mild steel material qualifier and rely solely on 'modular' are excluded to avoid collision.
